title: Modern Warfare 4's campaign wins over Steam 🎖️
subject: modernwarfare4
description:
Have you started the Modern Warfare 4 campaign yet? 👇

Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 holds a Very Positive user rating on Steam after campaign early access opened October 16, 2026, with more than 80% of early reviews recommending it. Multiplayer hasn't launched yet. The full game from Infinity Ward releases October 23, 2026.

Sources: Call of Duty Blog (campaign early access), Windows Central (Oct 17, 2026), Khel Now (Oct 18, 2026), Tech4Gamers (Oct 18, 2026)

scenes.text: Black Ops 7, Black Ops 6 and Modern Warfare 3 all started far lower there.
The story runs on two tracks. Private Park, a young South Korean soldier, fights a North Korean invasion, while Captain Price goes rogue.
Multiplayer isn't out yet, so the score covers the campaign.
The full game launches October 23 on consoles and PC.
